# Structure

The Structure fieldtype allows you to select an entry managed by Structure in the control panel and when used in a template it will output the URL to that entry.

:::note
The following examples use a field named `structure_field`. This should be replaced with your field name.
:::

<Tabs groupId="template-language">
<TabItem value="twig" label="Twig">

```twig
{{ entry.structure_field }}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="blade" label="Blade">

```php
{{ $entry->structure_field }}
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>
